text:
Nina (PM): Kicking off plan for `priority-tenant graduated fallback` rollout. Objective: enable per-tenant latency/cost-driven fallback that honors customer tier and preserves session continuity. Need gating, tenant-exemption UX, and telemetry requirements.

Ethan (Eng): Concept ACK. Important: support 3 lanes (platinum/gold/silver) with separate ramp speeds and rollback policies. Also need cross-variant cache compatibility checks.

Riya (Product Ops): From customers: platinum want a 7-day notice + opt-in toggle; gold wants 3-day notice; silver auto-apply with opt-out. We'll prod the opt-out API and update the UI.

Len (SRE): Suggested technical gates per lane:
- Platinum: p95 < 600ms, 5xx < 0.3% over 24h
- Gold: p95 < 500ms, 5xx < 0.25% over 12h
- Silver: p95 < 450ms, 5xx < 0.2% over 6h
Hard abort if p95 > 1000ms or 5xx > 2% in any region. Also monitor host GPU utilization and queue depth.

Anu (CS): For big accounts: provide a preview endpoint `preview.redwood.net/fallback/<tenant>` so they can compare outputs before route flip. Need audit log entries when toggles change.

Ethan (Eng): Proposed rollout phases (per-lane):
Phase A - Local shadow + A/B sampling (24h): run fallback variant in shadow + sample 1% A/B for quality scoring
Phase B - Lane micro: apply to 1% of lane's eligible sessions for 4h
Phase C - Lane ramp: 5% -> 20% over 24h with gates
Phase D - Lane full: 100% of eligible sessions for that lane if gates pass
We treat platinum/gold/silver separately and run platinum first.

Infra-bot: Example flag payload for tenant overrides:
```
flag: tenant_fallback_v1
scope: tenant:12345
lanes: {platinum}
overrides: {sticky:true, preview_endpoint:true, audit:true}
```

Len (SRE): Session stickiness rules: if session has KV cache or >1 conversation turn, keep variant binding until session TTL or explicit flush. If cache version mismatch -> trigger safe-fallback to original model and mark tenant for data-migration.

Riya (Product Ops): Legal/Compliance: private deployments (VPC/on-prem) must have an admin opt-in; we cannot auto-route in Private mode. Add a checkbox in contract template.

Ethan (Eng): Quality gate: compute pairwise embedding cosine between baseline and fallback responses on sampled queries; require mean cosine > 0.92 and 95th percentile > 0.85 for acceptance. Also compute a simple task-success proxy metric for the customer's top intents where available.

Anu (CS): Rollback and observability: when rollback happens capture last 30min of traces, error logs, and a sample of 500 requests to S3 (PII redacted). Also push an automated customer email if rollback affected platinum.

Len (SRE): Ops automation commands:
- `redwood rollout status --flag tenant_fallback_v1 --tenant 12345`
- `redwood rollout rollback --flag tenant_fallback_v1 --region ap-southeast-1 --reason high_p95`
If oscillation detected (more than 2 rollbacks in 3h) auto-disable flag for that region and page infra.

Riya (Product Ops): Launch checklist (short):
- Tenant opt-out API + UI ready
- Preview endpoints live for platinum customers
- Docs + support playbook published
- Dashboards: lane-specific p50/p95/p99, 5xx, cos_sim, cost_delta
- On-call rota for first 72h of platinum ramp

Ethan (Eng): A/B sampling plan: route sampled requests in shadow to both variants and compute cos_sim + businessProxy. If drift > threshold abort. We'll store evaluation results in eval-db with 14-day retention.

Infra-bot: Config example for per-region gradual weights (eu-central-1):
```
region: eu-central-1
lanes:
  platinum: [1%, 5%, 20%, 100%]
  gold: [0.5%, 2%, 10%, 100%]
  silver: [0.1%, 0.5%, 5%, 100%]
sticky_sessions: true
shadow_period: 24h
```

Len (SRE): Safety nuance: Dedicated capacity customers that reserved specific hardware must be treated as separate lane — do not auto-fallback across Dedicated clusters. Instead notify SRE and propose a manual migration plan.

Nina (PM): Action items: Ethan to spec A/B evaluator + cos_sim job by Wed EOD (TICKET ENG-9001). Len to draft runbook pages and automation hooks (TICKET SRE-4100). Riya to prepare customer comms for platinum cohort (TICKET PRODOPS-220). Anu will coordinate preview onboarding for top 5 customers. We'll reconvene Tues 10am PT for sign-off.

ops-bot: Feature flag `tenant_fallback_v1` created in staging by Nina at 2024-05-21T09:03:02Z.

Nina (PM): Thanks all. If no objections I'll mark this PRD ready and start scheduling implementation sprints. :raised_hands:
